$comment: Advisories the dependency gate tolerates, each with a reason and an expiry. Past its date a waiver FAILS the pipeline until the dependency is fixed or the waiver is renewed under review — the same rule feature flags live by. Read by scripts/dependency-audit.mjs.

advisories.reason: Owner-approved (2026-10-27) temporary waiver. zod 3 has no patched release; the fix starts at zod 4.6.6, so the remedy is the monorepo-wide zod 4 migration, done as its own change. Exposure is bounded meanwhile: every JSON body is capped at 1 MB (8 MB only on the authenticated custody-memo routes).
